financial constraints have a significant negative impact on firm survival and a significant positive impact on firm growth.

(1) financially constrained firms are more likely to exit the market, ( 2) financially constrained firms grow more slowly, in terms of sales, capital stock and employment and ( 3) financially constrained firms experience a higher productivity growth in the early years after the shock.
